data.headline: Raise price 3% now and boost marketing 15%
data.why: The plan adds $21.6k expected profit versus steady rival pricing. Higher price lifts margin per card; extra marketing recovers volume lost to the $5 gap with TechNova. Cash on hand covers the marketing spend without a cash crunch.
data.watch_out: If the GPU cost surge assumed in the scenario hits, unit cost jumps ~$74 and wipes out the new margin. The model shows a 5th-percentile gain of only $7.9k, so a cost shock could flip the result to a loss.
data.recheck_when: When Taiwan fab expansion news confirms or denies a GPU cost increase, or if TechNova cuts price further.
